items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: Cricket said, Daddy give me the horn. I gave it to him. ... So I was showing the kid and Cricket said, Daddy give me the horn.

ctx.x: Long enough when I had the baby. (LAUGHTER)
Cricket's - I think he's 29. He was born in 1943, 'cause we were down in Cafe Society downtown.
